about: Labelled pictures for the screenshot reading measurement (plan 98, lane I, step 1). One entry per picture. 'file' is a name inside the workshop's screenshots/plan98 folder (or inside any folder given to the script with --root); an entry may also carry 'path', an absolute path, which wins over 'file'. 'game' is the full name, 'game_aliases' other ways a reply may fairly name the same game. 'scene' is one of title, menu, play, pause, loading, other. 'boss' is the boss or enemy that is on screen, or empty when there is none; 'boss_aliases' are fair alternative names. 'running_game_known' is true when the picture was taken with the game running, so its app id ('app_id', 'app_name') can be handed to the ask; the script then asks twice, once with the game known and once with nothing known. When it is false the script asks only once, with nothing known. 'scene_words' (optional) replaces the script's own list of words that count as naming the scene. The first three entries are Deck captures that were already on this PC, labelled by looking at them. The rest are block K2's pictures (workshop screenshots/plan98), one entry per distinct picture: where K2 saved one capture under two scene names (Brotato, Hades, Half-Life 2, God of War title and menu) only the best-fitting scene is kept. Every picture carries Steam's performance overlay (GPU/CPU/FPS numbers, top left); it is left in on purpose. 'in_library' false marks a game the library holds no notes for; its app id is then the Steam id, and the script ignores the field.
